description:
Have you ever wanted to create something so far from "normal" that you  think it's crazy?......

Well.......that's what we've done right here. Our second Marvel Ice Cream and again, it's straight from the movies. Mentioned in Avengers: Infinity War, Tony Stark was going to avoid dairy but Ben & Jerry's went and named a flavour after him....Although Dr Strange thought it was "Chalky". I assure you, this is NOT CHALKY.

Please share this video to any Marvel fans you might know and might appreciate the making of. 

What makes this video different, is not only the cost of the ice cream itself, but the video is to celebrate 150 Subscribers here on YouTube which is AMAZING!! Thank you so much. 

There are no known ingredients for this flavour, we just went with what Tony Stark might have liked. This video is an intense, movie style video and took me waaaaay to long to make and edit. With that in mind, we hope you enjoy what is possibly, the most expensive ice cream we'll make and definately the most intense ice cream making video you are ever likely to see (until I do it again for 500 Subs ;)

NOTE: I've put a "normal" size recipe below with the costs of the extras you'll need. The total cost is based on you NOT having anything. 

Ice Cream Base (22.3% Fat content, MSNF 8%, Suagr 16.1%, Total Solids 46%):

500ml Milk (1.8% fat) - £0.34
600ml Double Cream (Heavy Cream) (49% fat) - £1.65
6 Egg Yolks - £1.10
220g Dark Muscovado - £0.68
40g SMP (after chilled) - £0.05
1 Tahitian vanilla bean + seeds (ours was LARGE) - £14 pack of two
1.5 tbsp Frangelico (can leave out to be honest) - £16 per 70cl bottle
200g Chopped Piedmont Hazelnuts - £10 for 200g

Whisky Caramel Sauce:

200g Granulated Sugar - £0.15
60ml Water - £0.? there is a cost there somewhere ;)
120ml Double Cream (Heavy Cream) £0.34
2 TBSP Laphroaig Whisky - £35 per 70cl bottle

Decoration:

24Ct Gold Leaf (1 leaf per serving) (80x80 x 5 sheets £13.50)

TOTAL COST: £92.81 per 1.5L
Assuming you make a batch large enough for the full bottles of booze. 


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)
